items.title: Orrin Keepnews interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: actually I think Helen and I intended to co-produce a live date together

ctx.x: Well it’s funny, the answer always has to be yes and no. Because I’ll always — if I look at somebody who went on and it happened to practically everybody. I mean for instance if you ask me that question about Wes Montgomery I would have no trouble saying definitely not did I think that what happened to Wes was terrible and very possibly shortened his life because I know that he was pretty uptight about being put into this pop bag and playing all these heavily arranged and pop-derived material but Cannon pretty…

him up a notch to a major label, and he was pulled away from us. And I didn’t think anything sensible or helpful or intelligent was done to his career subsequently. Bill Evans also went on to a — although there what happened was he kind of knew that he was kind of good in the sense that even though when Bill first went to Verve, and that was a matter of Bill left Riverside with a year to go on his contract which was because we were in existence, we were starting to have real money problems and frankly Bill had…
Speaking of him I wanted to get your reaction on this if I could. Let’s see if I found the kind of, this is like a blindfold test.
